Scenario fixture: landmark-role-name-present

Each target has a stable id of the form lrn_case_NN.

A. Named

01 — PASS: role="region" named by aria-label
News
02 — PASS: role="form" named by aria-labelledby pointing at its visible heading

Newsletter

03 — PASS: role="region" named by title, the last naming source landmarks have
Links

B. Unnamed

04 — CANTTELL: role="region" with no name
Stray
05 — CANTTELL: role="form" with no name
06 — CANTTELL: an explicit role="form" on a <form> asks for a landmark as much as on a <div>
07 — CANTTELL: the role is the role attribute's first token, so role="region note" is a region
Aside text
08 — CANTTELL: a whitespace-only aria-label is no name
Blank label
09 — CANTTELL: aria-labelledby pointing at an id that does not exist is no name
Dangling reference

C. Not applicable

10 — NEUTRAL: an unnamed <section> with no role asks for no landmark
Plain section
11 — NEUTRAL: an unnamed <form> with no role asks for no landmark
12 — NEUTRAL: role="navigation" needs no name; landmark-unique deals with repeated ones
Links

D. Ineligible

13 — INELIGIBLE: display:none removes it from the accessibility tree
Hidden
14 — INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden on an ancestor removes it from the accessibility tree
Hidden

End of fixture.
